displayName: Nightlite — SQLite Viewer for Databases, MBTiles & GeoPackage
description: View SQLite databases, MBTiles and GeoPackage files (.sqlite, .db, .mbtiles, .gpkg) in dark mode, even when they are tens of gigabytes. Fast, private and read-only.
virtualWorkspaces.description: Nightlite reads databases with SQLite, which needs a file on a local or remote disk.
